candidate.title: Obstruction-class transport map

gates.name: Precise theorem-shaped statement
gates.question: Can the candidate be stated as a formula, law, or divergence rather than a visual impression?

gates.name: Exact finite-field interpretation
gates.question: Is there an exact F_q[t] object or known algebraic mechanism on the theorem side?

gates.name: Integer-prime holdout evidence
gates.question: Was an integer-prime analogue preregistered and checked on unseen ranges?

gates.name: Local/null/random controls
gates.question: Does the candidate beat local baselines, random controls, and known leakage/placebo tests?

gates.name: Compression / low parameter count
gates.question: Is the rule simpler than the data and not explained by tuning many fitted knobs?

gates.name: Scale and field stability
gates.question: Does the result survive changes in degree, q, range, or normalization?

gates.name: Novelty audit
gates.question: Is it not just a renamed known theorem, local obstruction, or plotting artifact?

gates.name: Reproducible code, logs, plots
gates.question: Are the scripts, raw JSON/MD artifacts, and evidence pack present?

gates.name: Plausible proof path
gates.question: Can the result be organized into definitions, finite-field proposition, integer analogue, and obstruction/conjecture?

gates.name: Expert-ready evidence pack
gates.question: Is there a concise pack with object, mechanism, holdouts, controls, novelty, and artifacts?

precise_statement.evidence: Obstruction map contains 7 finite-field failure modes with theorem-shaped identities, same-form integer tests, transport classes, and eligibility reasons.

finite_field_anchor.evidence: Every class begins from an exact finite-field failure mode or identity: repeated roots, local admissibility, discriminant characters, characteristic-2 trace parity, coefficient-space Morse failure, residue-theorem obstruction, or complete-shell cancellation.

integer_holdout.evidence: Cycle 011 intentionally runs no integer holdout: the transport map found no non-exhausted obstruction class that justifies a new statistic.

controls.evidence: The only honest transports are known squarefactor/admissibility controls already absorbed in prior cycles; no new class has controls to clear.

compression.evidence: The classification uses one fixed rule: finite-field failure mode -> same-form integer obstruction -> transport class -> experiment eligibility.

scale_stability.evidence: No scale ladder applies because no obstruction class is allowed to proceed to a new experiment.

novelty_audit.evidence: Novelty screen blocks the branch: actionable classes=0, honest known local transports=2, non-actionable/no-new transports=5.

reproducibility.evidence: JSON/MD/SVG/script artifacts are present and generated by the obstruction-class transport script.

proof_path.evidence: Every same-form obstruction is known local structure already controlled, and every other finite-field failure mode has no honest integer transport.

expert_pack.evidence: No expert-ready breakthrough pack exists because the branch has no non-exhausted integer obstruction, no holdout, and no controls.
